package app

// Generates the Go JSON fixtures for recur-services' DTO round-trip tests
// (crates/services/tests/dto_roundtrip.rs). Kept in the Rust crate as
// tests/fixtures/gen_fixtures.go.txt; to regenerate, copy it to
// internal/app/zz_rust_fixtures_test.go, run
//
//	RECUR_RUST_FIXTURES=$PWD/crates/services/tests/fixtures/dto go test ./internal/app -run TestRustDTOFixtures
//
// and delete the copy.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"recur/internal/lsp"
	"recur/internal/usage"
)

func TestRustDTOFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("RECUR_RUST_FIXTURES")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("RECUR_RUST_FIXTURES not set")
	}
	types := []any{
		AppChatSelection{}, AssignedIssue{}, IssueLabel{}, BundleSettingInfo{}, BundleSkipInfo{},
		ClaudeStatus{}, CodexStatus{}, CommandInfo{}, CommandPromptDTO{}, CompatibleTestResult{},
		CursorStatus{}, EditorBuffer{}, EditorFileView{}, EditorScratchDoc{}, EditorSession{},
		EditorSessionMeta{}, EditorSessionPatch{}, EnsureResult{}, FlagDimension{}, FlagOption{},
		GrammarInfo{}, IssuesView{}, LanguageServerInfo{}, LoopInfo{}, ModelChoice{}, ModelGroup{},
		PaletteSearchDTO{}, PaletteSearchGroupDTO{}, PolicyInfo{}, PromptActionInfo{}, PromptArgInfo{},
		PromptCompleteHitDTO{}, PromptCompleteRequestDTO{}, PromptCompleteResultDTO{}, PromptContextDTO{},
		PromptResultDTO{}, RoleInfo{}, RunContextDTO{}, RunResultDTO{}, ShellState{}, SnippetInfo{},
		SymbolInfo{}, TerminalDockChrome{}, TerminalPaletteInfo{}, TerminalThemeInfo{}, ThemeInfo{},
		ThemePreviewInfo{}, WorkspaceChatSelection{},
		usage.Snapshot{}, usage.ProviderQuota{}, usage.Window{}, usage.ModelRow{}, usage.CursorUsageConnect{},
		lsp.SessionInfo{},
	}
	for _, v := range types {
		ty := reflect.TypeOf(v)
		for _, mode := range []string{"zero", "empty", "full"} {
			val := reflect.New(ty).Elem()
			if mode != "zero" {
				fill(val, mode == "full", 0, 0)
			}
			b, err := json.Marshal(val.Interface())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			name := filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("%s.%s.json", ty.Name(), mode))
			if err := os.WriteFile(name, b, 0o644); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
}

// fill sets every field: full mode with distinct non-zero values (floats
// alternate integral and fractional; strings carry HTML-escaped runes),
// empty mode with non-nil empty slices, maps and pointers.
func fill(v reflect.Value, full bool, depth, level int) {
	switch v.Kind() {
	case reflect.String:
		if full {
			v.SetString(fmt.Sprintf("s%d<&>", depth))
		}
	case reflect.Bool:
		v.SetBool(full)
	case reflect.Int, reflect.Int64, reflect.Int32:
		if full {
			v.SetInt(int64(7 + depth))
		}
	case reflect.Uint64:
		if full {
			v.SetUint(uint64(9 + depth))
		}
	case reflect.Float64:
		if full {
			if depth%2 == 0 {
				v.SetFloat(3)
			} else {
				v.SetFloat(0.25)
			}
		}
	case reflect.Slice:
		s := reflect.MakeSlice(v.Type(), 0, 1)
		if full && level < 4 {
			e := reflect.New(v.Type().Elem()).Elem()
			fill(e, full, depth+1, level+1)
			s = reflect.Append(s, e)
		}
		v.Set(s)
	case reflect.Map:
		m := reflect.MakeMap(v.Type())
		if full && level < 4 {
			for _, k := range []string{"b", "a"} {
				e := reflect.New(v.Type().Elem()).Elem()
				fill(e, full, depth+1, level+1)
				m.SetMapIndex(reflect.ValueOf(k), e)
			}
		}
		v.Set(m)
	case reflect.Pointer:
		p := reflect.New(v.Type().Elem())
		fill(p.Elem(), full, depth+1, level+1)
		v.Set(p)
	case reflect.Struct:
		for i := 0; i < v.NumField(); i++ {
			if v.Type().Field(i).IsExported() {
				fill(v.Field(i), full, depth+i+1, level+1)
			}
		}
	}
}
